headline: Maui Liquor Control Commission Launches Director Search

meeting.body: Maui Liquor Control Commission Launches Director Search
meeting.summary: The Liquor Control Commission voted to use an open application process and create a small group to hire a search firm for a new director.
meeting.recap: The Liquor Control Commission held a special meeting.[[0:00:30]] The director of the Department of Liquor Control announced his retirement at the commission's last meeting.[[0:04:08]] The deputy corporation counsel said the county rule calls for a hiring process open to any candidate.[[0:04:35]] The job requires five years of law enforcement experience, three of them in administrative work.[[0:11:15]] The director said the last search took about eight months.[[0:16:19]] The commission voted unanimously for an open application process.[[0:33:47]] The commission voted unanimously to create a temporary investigative group, a small team that works outside public meetings.[[1:10:02]] The group will hire a search firm and work with it to gather, screen and rank applications.[[1:10:08]] The director asked commissioners not to form opinions based on unsubstantiated complaints.[[1:21:53]] The commission voted unanimously to let the chair work out any changes to the director's executive coaching arrangement.[[1:23:33]] The next meeting is October 14.[[1:24:29]] The November meeting moved to November 16 at 9 a.m.[[1:30:33]] November 23 was held for a possible special meeting to prepare for interviews.[[1:31:37]]
decided: The commission approved the agenda for the meeting.
The commission authorized the chair to talk with the executive coach and make any needed changes on its behalf.
meeting.next: The chair will contact the executive coach about changes to the coaching arrangement. Director hiring is a standing item on the regular agenda and can be discussed at the October meeting.

moments.q: Why the special meeting was called: the director's retirement
The search group's duties read aloud
"Don't form opinions based on unsubstantiated complaints"
